title: Proof of gravity spectral prefactor
html:
Proof. Proof of gravity spectral prefactor

Proof. The unified mass formula (unified mass formula) decomposes mass as \sum_k \alpha_k \mathfrak{m}^{(k)}_{q,\mathcal{K}}. For k \geq 4, no specific hyperbolic-knot ideal remains in the centre Z(A) (universal residue). The surviving structure is the dualizing-complex residue. Its normalisation is \alpha = m_e \cdot 8 G by the Planck-unit convention. Solving for G yields the displayed expression. \square

Connection to substrate geometry.

The remarks Gravity emergent and GR substrate geometry describe gravity as the CR-manifold curvature of the substrate. The proposition above identifies the categorical counterpart: gravity is the high-stratum residue of the Hecke-algebraic mass functional, carrying G as its universal prefactor. The two viewpoints are dual. CR geometry is the substrate face; the Plancherel residue is the categorical face.

Corollaries.

  1. No fitting. The gravitational constant G is not an independent parameter. It is strictly the prefactor \alpha/8m_e from the spectral tail. Its numerical value is fixed by Planck-unit normalisation.
  2. q-dependence. If the residual cyclotomic pole structure (full pole structure) varies with q, then G_q must vary identically. At q_0, the universal residue must reproduce the empirical Newton constant. This provides a rigid cross-check between the cosmological and microscopic sectors.
  3. Falsifiability. Any deviation of the deep-tower mass from \alpha \cdot \sum_{k \geq 4} \Phi_k implies either a new stratum prefactor or a violation of Plancherel completeness.
